groups.name: physics
groups.summary: Inspect and configure 3D/2D physics: settings, collision matrix, rigidbodies, forces, materials, casts, stepping, joints.

actions.name: ping
actions.summary: Report the physics readiness summary: gravity, solver settings and simulation mode.

actions.name: get_settings
actions.summary: Read the 3D or 2D physics world settings.

actions.name: set_settings
actions.summary: Write whitelisted 3D or 2D physics world settings.

actions.name: get_collision_matrix
actions.summary: Read the layer collision matrix (lower triangle).

actions.name: set_collision_matrix
actions.summary: Enable or disable collision between two layers.

actions.name: get_rigidbody
actions.summary: Read a Rigidbody or Rigidbody2D.

actions.name: configure_rigidbody
actions.summary: Write whitelisted Rigidbody or Rigidbody2D properties.

actions.name: apply_force
actions.summary: Apply a force, torque or explosion to a rigidbody.

actions.name: create_physics_material
actions.summary: Create a PhysicMaterial (3D) or PhysicsMaterial2D resource.

actions.name: configure_physics_material
actions.summary: Write whitelisted physics material properties.

actions.name: assign_physics_material
actions.summary: Assign a physics material to a collider on a target.

actions.name: raycast
actions.summary: Cast a ray and return the first hit.

actions.name: raycast_all
actions.summary: Cast a ray and return every hit.

actions.name: linecast
actions.summary: Cast between two points and return the first hit.

actions.name: shapecast
actions.summary: Sweep a sphere, box or capsule and return the first hit.

actions.name: overlap
actions.summary: Return every collider overlapping a sphere, box or capsule.

actions.name: simulate_step
actions.summary: Advance the physics world manually and report rigidbody motion.

actions.name: add_joint
actions.summary: Add a joint to a target.

actions.name: configure_joint
actions.summary: Configure an existing joint's properties, motor, limits, spring or drive.

actions.name: remove_joint
actions.summary: Remove joints from a target.

actions.name: validate
actions.summary: Sweep the loaded scenes for common physics misconfigurations.

target.description: GameObject name, hierarchy path or instance id.

searchMethod.description: Name, hierarchy path, instance id, tag, layer or component.

groups.name: probuilder
groups.summary: Create and edit ProBuilder meshes: shapes, topology, face material/colour/UV, smoothing, validation.

actions.name: ping
actions.summary: Report ProBuilder availability and the resolved type surface.

actions.name: create-shape
actions.summary: Generate a ProBuilder primitive.

actions.name: create-poly-shape
actions.summary: Extrude a polygon outline into a solid.

actions.name: extrude-faces
actions.summary: Extrude faces by a distance.

actions.name: extrude-edges
actions.summary: Extrude edges by a distance.

actions.name: bevel-edges
actions.summary: Bevel edges.

actions.name: subdivide
actions.summary: Subdivide faces.

actions.name: delete-faces
actions.summary: Delete faces.

actions.name: bridge-edges
actions.summary: Bridge two open edges.

actions.name: connect-elements
actions.summary: Connect elements across selected faces or edges.

actions.name: detach-faces
actions.summary: Detach faces into a separate object.

actions.name: flip-normals
actions.summary: Flip the normals of faces.

actions.name: merge-faces
actions.summary: Merge faces into one.

actions.name: combine-meshes
actions.summary: Combine several ProBuilder meshes into one.

actions.name: merge-objects
actions.summary: Merge several objects into one ProBuilder mesh.

actions.name: duplicate-and-flip
actions.summary: Duplicate faces and flip the copies.

actions.name: create-polygon
actions.summary: Create a face from existing vertices.

actions.name: merge-vertices
actions.summary: Merge vertices into a single one.

actions.name: weld-vertices
actions.summary: Weld nearby vertices.

actions.name: split-vertices
actions.summary: Split shared vertices.

actions.name: move-vertices
actions.summary: Translate vertices by an offset.

actions.name: insert-vertex
actions.summary: Insert a vertex on a face or edge.

actions.name: append-vertices-to-edge
actions.summary: Insert evenly spaced vertices along edges.

actions.name: select-faces
actions.summary: Select faces by direction, growth, flood or loop.

actions.name: set-face-material
actions.summary: Assign a material to faces.

actions.name: set-face-color
actions.summary: Assign a vertex colour to faces.

actions.name: set-face-uvs
actions.summary: Apply UV scale/offset/rotation/flip to faces.

actions.name: get-mesh-info
actions.summary: Report mesh counts, bounds, materials and optional face/edge detail.

actions.name: convert-to-probuilder
actions.summary: Convert a plain Mesh into a ProBuilder mesh.

actions.name: set-smoothing
actions.summary: Set the smoothing group on faces.

actions.name: auto-smooth
actions.summary: Apply automatic smoothing by angle threshold.

actions.name: center-pivot
actions.summary: Move the mesh so its pivot is centred.

actions.name: freeze-transform
actions.summary: Bake the transform into the vertices.

actions.name: set-pivot
actions.summary: Move the pivot to a world position without moving the mesh.

actions.name: validate-mesh
actions.summary: Report degenerate triangles and unused vertices.

actions.name: repair-mesh
actions.summary: Remove degenerate triangles from the mesh.

target.description: GameObject name, hierarchy path or instance id.

shapeType.description: Cube, Cylinder, Sphere, Plane, Cone, Torus, Pipe, Arch, Stair, CurvedStair, Door, Prism.
